default.description: Main window: app commands listed explicitly plus core event listen/unlisten. No fs/shell/http plugins.

diagnostics.description: Phase 1 native spikes (ADR-07, ADR-12). Enabled only by tauri.dev.conf.json; beta/release list just `default`. Files go through Rust commands, so no dialog/fs plugin permissions are granted to the WebView; notifications are probed with the plugin's JS API.
